sourceSummary: Portsmouth 2026/27 post-window squad cross-check using FootballSquads and current transfer confirmations, with latest published Transfermarkt market values. Benjamin Arthur's Portsmouth loan and Abu Kamara's permanent Portsmouth return are treated as current-roster truth even where older valuation pages still show their parent/previous clubs.
